var session = WebRTC.Media; // session is a required global variable if configuring manually. Run before loading main.js but after webrtc.js. session.version = "30.1"; // added director claim-time room admission controls (cap + bypass key + approval queue) session.streamID = session.generateStreamID(); // randomly generates a streamID for this session.
